text:
Good morning everyone and happy Sunday.

Here’s my simple creative workflow: Image → GPT Image 2 Storyboard → Seedance 2.0 @yapper_so 

From a single still image to a cinematic motion sequence, this process makes visual storytelling faster, cleaner and more intentional.
